R4.reason: claim-04 proves cage() reverts for every non-ward caller (wards[caller] == 0) over every other storage. Not proved: rely/deny by a non-ward; a caller with wards[caller] not in {0, 1} (unreachable by bytecode inspection, not proved); cage/rely/deny success for a ward.

R5.reason: claim-05 proves join reverts with live == 0 for every caller, every storage and every 256-bit (usr, wad). Not proved: calldata longer than 68 bytes; callvalue > 0 (R9); a call from a non-top-level frame (Aasm-toplevel-call). 'Before any external call' is by bytecode inspection.

R6.reason: Not proved. join's value movement needs the external calls Vat.slip and WETH.transferFrom composed (assume-guarantee over unaudited callees); Stage C is open (Finding 0006 + correction). The overflow guard (wad >= 2^255 reverts, Finding 0003 row 6) is outside this claim set.

R7.reason: Not proved. exit's value movement needs Vat.slip and WETH.transfer composed; open (Finding 0006). The overflow guard (Finding 0003 row 5) is outside this claim set.

R8.reason: Not proved as stated. Claims 01-05 show storage is unchanged on the three getter paths and the two revert paths only; no success path of join/exit/cage/rely/deny is covered.

R9.reason: Not proved. Every claim fixes callvalue = 0; the non-payable guard (Finding 0003 row 7, cage only) is outside this claim set.
